original.test: event matrix He-nucleus and charge null vectors

rows.material_requirement: Exact integer left-null vectors for every adopted event column; signed event outputs retain the original species order.
rows.limits: Integer coefficient check is separate from floating evaluated source/ledger parity.

rows.material_requirement: Each of the five source channels separately: independently accumulated photon power + internal energy source + BF excess-energy heat = 0.
rows.limits: Legacy ledger with caller-chosen compensating heat alone is insufficient; inspect the source-based isolated-channel test and independent reference outputs.

original.test: material-frame Planck/Boltzmann/Saha source zero for all represented channels

rows.material_requirement: Material Planck/Boltzmann/Saha cancellation for all five represented channel families on the registered finite energy/screen stencil, including both L/V BF families.
rows.limits: Finite tests are not a proof at every real continuum energy or every direction. The pointwise LTE argument remains the pinned T4 report; missing bands are not evaluated as zero.

original.test: finite-tilt boosted LTE remains source zero

rows.limits: Boosted LTE in the normal frame requires the consumer Doppler, screen and clock adapters; no such execution in this library task.

original.test: normal/material photon source parity with Dossier-II Eq.115-119 including screen transform

rows.limits: Dossier-II Eq.115-119 normal/material source+screen transformation is not implemented or tested here. Rotated real material screens do not test a Lorentz boost.

original.test: atomic proper-density normal-time parity with Dossier-III continuity

rows.limits: Atomic proper-density normal-time continuity needs the consumer transport/clock adapter. Collision RHS alone is not the continuity equation.
Material SharpLineDeltaPerJoule is not the direction-dependent normal-frame support E_n=epsilon/D.

original.test: bound-free threshold and table lookup use E_m=D E_n

rows.material_requirement: Use positive material E in eV for the pinned BF threshold/table branch; separate subthreshold zero from unknown above-threshold and invalid energy. Preserve J integration measure.
rows.limits: The material subcheck is Gate P only. Constructing E_m=D E_n and proving actual normal/material lookup equivalence remain Gate I; the original T4L08 cannot pass from this subcheck.

original.test: two-photon pair uses D1 E1n + D2 E2n=Delta_S

rows.material_requirement: Material pair uses E1=y DeltaS and E2=(1-y)DeltaS in one registry, actual T12, exchange-closed ordered weights, independent tagged marginal number and energy moments.
rows.limits: This does not test D1 E1n + D2 E2n=DeltaS. Normal-frame pair kinematics and lookup are deferred to Gate I.

original.test: P-bound-free full matrix source reduces to scalar isotropic formula when W_P=n_P I3/3

rows.material_requirement: Full P-bound-free matrix must reduce to the independent scalar isotropic result with WP=nP I3/3; no trace-only substitute for complex matrix parity.
rows.limits: Frozen finite q values and represented L/V tables only; no low-table or whole-grid admission.

original.test: 584/IR matrix event trace parity between atom and photon source

rows.material_requirement: Per-mode and assembled 584/IR atom and photon traces agree for complex WP,F, per-node screens, and exactly one caller-owned WP.
rows.limits: Material trace agreement does not validate normal-frame screen transformations or arbitrary-angle quadrature accuracy.

original.test: coverage mask returns explicit UNKNOWN outside domain and preserves LTE on represented modes

rows.material_requirement: Fail closed for unprovided source domains; accept physical subthreshold zero only as specified; LTE inside the same represented mask for forward and inverse.
rows.limits: UNKNOWN from original prose maps to typed MissingAuthority/OutOfBand, not successful numeric zero. Nonfinite/invalid inputs have their own error types.

original.test: no duplicate 2gamma total loss, no 584 continuum absorption added to atomic P decay

rows.material_requirement: One resolved two-photon atomic event loss; one full tagged marginal for physical photon moments; no added total decay or propagation-continuum correction in P atomic decay.
rows.limits: The Pbf independence test is not an implemented H/He propagation absorber. Source audit must also inspect the reachable API and ensure there is no extra continuum-to-P-decay term; future consumer collisions require a separate audit.

original.test: four-force moment equals scalar photon-energy ledger in material frame

rows.material_requirement: Direct material photon energy and directional momentum moment agree with the source/event energy ledger; internal plus kinetic energy, not heat alone, supplies matter energy.
rows.limits: Q_m=-Q_gamma is imposed by definition; independent scalar/phase-space agreement is a different check. No species-force partition, gravity coupling or trajectory validation.

original.test: species-drift BF inverse is rejected unless a rederived electron distribution kernel is supplied

rows.material_requirement: P/S inverse accepts only the adopted common material/electron-frame Maxwell policy. Species drift must return MissingAuthority without partial numeric source output.
rows.limits: Rejection does not rederive or implement a drifting/non-Maxwell electron distribution.
